name: renorm_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::renorm_(Tensor(a!) self, Scalar p, int dim, Scalar maxnorm) -> Tensor(a!). Renormalizes slices of self in place so their p-norm does not exceed maxnorm, returning the same Tensor object and storage. Tests cover multiple ranks, dimensions, p values, norm limits, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, identity, and invalid p or dimension values.
